component.create.label: Create component
component.create.params: {ids?}  (one frame/group becomes a component; several layers are wrapped in one)

component.list.label: List components
component.list.params: {} → [{id, name, type, page, instances, folder (the Assets panel's folders: page, frames, slash names), label, library?}]

node.create.label: Create layer
node.create.params: {type: rectangle|ellipse|polygon|star|line|arrow|vector|text|frame|section|component|slice, x?, y? (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width?, height?, parent? (id; default: the page), index?, name?, text? (for text), path? (SVG path data for vector), props? {node.set keys}, select? (default true)}

node.set.label: Set properties
node.set.params: name, visible, locked, opacity (0-1), blend, x, y (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width, height, rotation (degrees), fills (paints or colours), fill (colour), strokes, stroke (colour), strokeWeight, strokeAlign (inside|center|outside), strokeSides [t,r,b,l], strokeTopWeight / strokeRightWeight / strokeBottomWeight / strokeLeftWeight (one side; turns on individual strokes), strokeCap / startCap / endCap, strokeJoin, miterAngle (degrees: sharper joins bevel; or miterLimit as a ratio), dashes [..], widthProfile (preset uniform|wedge|taper|eye|rounded|pinch, [[t, scale], ...] or null), brush (preset id, {preset, spacing, sizeJitter, rotationJitter, scatter, seed} or null), cornerRadius (n or [tl,tr,br,bl]), cornerSmoothing (0-1), effects, clip, isMask, layout (null|horizontal|vertical|grid|{...}), gap, crossGap, padding (n or [t,r,b,l]), paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left, mainAlign (min|center|max, or the auto gaps spaceBetween|spaceAround|spaceEvenly), crossAlign (min|center|max|baseline: first text baselines, horizontal layouts), contentAlign (wrapped lines: auto = packed where crossAlign says | spaceBetween), wrap (rows of a horizontal layout, columns of a vertical one), strokesIncluded (the frame's inside stroke takes up space), reverseZ (canvas stacking: true = first on top), columnGap / rowGap (aliases of gap / crossGap), gridColumns, gridRows, columnTracks / rowTracks ([120 | "1fr" | "auto" | {sizing, value}]), gridColumn / gridRow (0-based cell anchor, null = auto), gridColumnSpan, gridRowSpan, gridAlignH / gridAlignV (a grid child's alignment in its cell: min|center|max, auto/null = the frame's), sizingH / sizingV (fixed|hug|fill), absolute (ignore auto layout; follows constraints), minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight (null removes), constraints {horizontal, vertical}, grids, exports, characters, fontFamily, fontStyle, fontSize, lineHeight (auto|px|"150%"), letterSpacing (px|"2%"), textAlign (left|center|right|justified), textAlignVertical, textAutoResize (widthAndHeight|height|none|truncate), textDecoration, textDecorationStyle (solid|dotted|wavy), textDecorationThickness / textDecorationOffset (auto|px|"10%" of the font size; the offset runs from the baseline down to an underline's top edge), textDecorationSkipInk (underlines break around descenders), textDecorationColor (colour, or auto/null: the text's), textCase (original|upper|lower|title|smallCaps), paragraphSpacing, paragraphIndent, listStyle (none|bulleted|numbered; with start/end: the paragraphs those chars touch), indentation (list nesting level 0-8, same range rule), listSpacing (px between list items, in place of paragraphSpacing), hangingPunctuation, hangingList (markers outside the box), leadingTrim (vertical trim: none|capHeight), maxLines, features ({tag: bool}, e.g. {"liga": false, "tnum": true}), fontVariations / variationSettings ({axis: number}, e.g. {"wght": 550, "wdth": 85}; null = none), pointCount, innerRadius, arcStart, arcSweep, arcInner, booleanOperation (a boolean group's operation, or an operand's own; null: the group's), operandOperation (a layer in a boolean group: how it combines with the operands below it; null: the group's), constrainProportions, description, interactions, overflow, pluginData {k: v}
